attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no saint of this name on any day; a grep of every `saint.json` for «Αππίων» and for Appion returns nothing, and the per-day sweep offered nothing but weaker rows. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence; the page gives no year, no country, no emperor and no judge, prints no life beyond one sentence and no hymn.
